summary: A lightweight Windows-based utility that automates Git workflows for managing, backing up, and synchronizing save files using batch scripts.
key_features: Automated push cycle (stage, commit, push) via AutoGit.bat
Structured backup naming convention for manual and automated saves
Configurable console output timeout for visibility
achievements: Designed and implemented a Windows batch-based automation layer for Git-driven save file synchronization. Solved workflow friction by scripting non-interactive push/pull cycles, addressing binary versioning constraints through Git LFS documentation, and establishing a robust naming convention for backup tracking. Configured credential management to enable seamless automated execution without manual authentication prompts.
